# Termux-Diffusion (v1.8.0)
> Official Z-Image Turbo (6.0B DiT) & Pure Native On-Device Diffusion Acceleration for Android Termux

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-diffusion
- Installation: `pip install termux-diffusion && termux-diffusion install
# or:
npm install termux-diffusion && npx termux-diffusion install`
- Architecture: Executes 6.0B DiT (Z-Image Turbo) and quantized Stable Diffusion models with Tri-Engine asymmetric offloading, layer streaming, Vulkan compute shaders, and ARMv8.2-A DotProd/FP16 NEON SIMD.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
import termux_diffusion as td

# Generate image using official on-device acceleration
image_path = td.generate(
    prompt="A cinematic photo of a neon cybernetic tiger walking in Seoul street at night",
    model="anime",
    steps=6,
    device="vulkan"
)
print(f"Generated and saved to Gallery: {image_path}")

```
